A major means a careful art lead would reject the piece.

summary: Geometry is right everywhere: every strip is 32 px, sits on the lip, has no gap or overlap, and darkens with distance. Treads show nosing at the far edge with the shadow on the near edge, so they read as going down. Both village scenes read well. Failures: snow stairs h1 (speckle reads as a grate) and h4 (a vent grille), and the snow treads lack the snow-white tops of the forward pieces. Peat and cave stairs h1 have a three-side rim, so they read as a framed mat. Ramps all pass; at h3-h4 they start to look stepped.
